reviews.comment:
Soy socio del ACA, quise ir a los baños... dios mio, una mugre, sin papel ni jabon, quise hablar con un señor que tenia una oficina vidriada a la salida de los baños exclusivo para socios y ni bola me dio, lamentable atención :-( me fui a cargar a la Puma de enfrente

(Translated by Google)
I'm an ACA member, I wanted to use the restrooms... oh my god, they were filthy, no toilet paper or soap. I tried to talk to a man who had a glass-fronted office at the exit of the restrooms, exclusively for members, and he didn't even acknowledge me. Terrible service :-( I went to refuel at the Puma gas station across the street.

reviewReply.comment: Sr Plomer lamentamos su mala experiencia, estamos tramitando el reemplazo de la empresa de limpieza .Nuestras disculpas por el mal momento.
